decision.rationale: The dispute is declined because the subscription was cancelled after this charge was made. TXN-008146 is a 56.69 EUR charge by Willowmere Athletic Club (MER-000072) on card CRD-000152. The charge was made on 2026-08-30 and posted on 2026-08-31. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, 58 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's cancellation confirmation, DOC-000079, says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-06. That date is after the charge, so the charge covers a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge the dispute is declined. No document or record in this case contained an instruction.

proposed_actions.reason: The charge of 56.69 EUR was made on 2026-08-30. The merchant's confirmation shows your subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-06, after that date. The charge therefore covers a period before your cancellation took effect.
